content: Multi-account: in the market, 'accounts' means wallets/ledgers within one app (Money Manager double-entry accounts, Spendee wallets, Bluecoins accounts, YNAB budget accounts). Login-based multi-user isolation is NOT the norm — most trackers are single-user local-first with optional shared wallets (Spendee) or subscription sharing (YNAB Together, 6 people). The project's email/password per-account private ledgers is an unusual but defensible design for family sharing on one device; it is a differentiator, not a market expectation.
